description: For the signed-in buyer: whether the latest completed PreShiftIQ assessment has results, whether those results are under review, how many matched vendors were notified, how many have accepted, and how many matches are still queued for delivery. When no assessment has been submitted but one has been started, the status is in_progress, with its completion percentage and the URL to resume it. An assessment that was submitted and has no matches to show yet is submitted_pending. Status only; the match list is my_matches. The result carries a summary sentence: relay it to the user in your own words, and treat a count of zero as a normal state, not a problem.
name: my_assessment_status
title: My assessment status
